synthesis.paragraph: Seven papers are grouped under the tag "Urban Transport and Accessibility", which covers a bike-sharing station optimization framework, cycling route choices using street-level images, group representation in household travel surveys, active urbanism implementation in the UK, congestion pricing acceptability in Hyderabad, a literature review of app-based GPS data for pedestrian mobility, and the effects of residential relocation voluntariness on travel behavior. Three papers carry the tag "Traffic and Road Safety", focusing on cycling route choices, driver yield decisions at junctions, and app-based GPS data for pedestrian mobility. Another three papers share the tag "Transportation Planning and Optimization", which includes the bike-sharing station optimization framework, congestion pricing acceptability in Hyderabad, and probabilistic modeling for traffic forecasting. Outside these groups, one paper analyzes the spatial structure of the less-than-truckload logistics network in the Pearl River Delta, another evaluates the technical and financial feasibility of repurposing abandoned shopping malls, and a third constructs a climate environmental vulnerability index for municipalities in South Africa's Gauteng Province.
